name: Fredericksburg in the Texas Hill Country

known.article: Fredericksburg in the Texas Hill Country AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Fredericksburg in the Texas Hill Country AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Few classic table-wine grapes keep their freshness in heat like this. It suits fortified wine, table grapes and raisins.
Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

soil.rock: Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.
